title: 2026 Maple Elementary After School Program for Kids
fullPassage: Keep your kids learning, active, and engaged after school! Join our exciting 2026 Maple Elementary After School Program designed for kids aged 5 – 12. Schedule: Monday to Thursday, 3:00 p.m. – 6:00 p.m. Location: Maple Elementary School, 123 Maple Lane. Activities by Day: Monday: Arts & Crafts. Tuesday: Homework Assistance. Wednesday: Sports & Outdoor Games. Thursday: Music, Dance, & Drama. Program Highlights: All activities and materials are provided free of charge. The program is supervised by trained, experienced staff. Registration Deadline: April 3. Program Start Date: May 4. How to Register: Visit mapleelemschool.com and complete the online registration form. (Registration cannot be completed over the phone.)
